bio.text: Barbara Ehardt represents Idaho House District 33, Seat A, and lives in Idaho Falls; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a fifth term.

The legislature biography says Ehardt was born and raised in Idaho Falls, attended North Idaho College and Idaho State University on a basketball scholarship, and was elected to the Idaho Falls City Council in 2013.
The biography lists 15 years as an NCAA Division I women's basketball coach, including as head coach at Cal State Fullerton, and says Ehardt owns and operates Coach E's Camps and Clinics.
